disclaimer: Research prototype for health risk assessment. Model outputs are research risk scores that require external validation. Not a medical device and not a diagnostic system.

holdout.policy: locked; used once after all development decisions were frozen

oof_prediction_policy: each row's out-of-fold score is the mean of its per-repeat predictions; every repeat's model never saw that row

space.sampling: random sampling WITH replacement; some combinations may be drawn more than once and others not at all
random sampling WITH replacement; some combinations may be drawn more than once and others not at all
